falsifiers: A worker changes a frozen Spec Kit artifact, owner test, or Airlock configuration.
A worker changes the other worker's implementation path.
Worker A can act on T201 or Worker B can act on T101/T102.
The revoked Worker A can act on T102 after the newer bundle is admitted.
The successor cannot continue from the accepted T101 checkpoint using only frozen artifacts and owner-signed handoff state.
The locally-green fixed-nonce producer survives the protected Airlock composition gate.
The valid producer and receiver fail the same frozen composition gate.
Any provider token or dollar spend occurs in this arm.
nonclaims: This arm does not run Spec Kit slash commands or reproduce Spec Kit agent reasoning.
The owner-authored artifacts use the pinned Spec Kit artifact structure and task conventions; they are not claimed to have been generated by the Spec Kit CLI.
Spec Kit convergence is not used as the final judge; Airlock owns executable composition acceptance.
This arm makes no claim about Claude, Codex, OpenAI, Anthropic, or any other live provider.
The fixture has no production or external side effect.
question: Can OpenLine compose beneath a pinned GitHub Spec Kit project definition so two task-scoped workers progress in parallel, one can be revoked and replaced from an accepted checkpoint, and Airlock rejects a locally-green cross-task violation while accepting the valid combined project?
terminal_success: Pinned Spec Kit artifacts remain unchanged; T101 and T201 make overlapping progress in isolated worktrees under separate Wallet authority; T101 reaches an independently verified checkpoint with T102 unresolved; Worker A is revoked and its T102 action is STOPPED/MANDATE_REVOKED; successor authority bound to the signed handoff completes T102 from the checkpoint; the fixed-nonce locally-green candidate is rejected by Airlock; the valid combined candidate is accepted; provider spend is zero.
